Description: The hero button is light blue until a vehicle is chosen, says why it is waiting, and a click takes you to the vehicle picker.
The header is taller: 72 px on desktop, 64 px on mobile. Jump links now land with the heading visible.
The strip above the header is gone. What it said is still on the page.
The hero wheel photo is no longer a link and shows no price; its measurements stay.
The row is now „Meistgekaufte Felgen“, sorted by paid orders of the last 90 days. Before the first sale it reads „Neu im Shop“; with fewer than four wheels in the shop it is hidden.
The highlight in „Wir lesen das Gutachten“ sits on the right row at every screen size we checked, low windows included.
Switching between the three vehicle tabs no longer makes the hero jump.
